_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — settings / pricing business shape. Preserves company settings (identity + VAT posture in basis points), quote terms (sign-off captured as approvedAt/approvedBy VERBATIM — null = not approved), work_roles (cost/sell hourly rates in integer öre), and an optional manual article. ZERO real PII: company identity is synthetic, email @example.test, orgnr masked (non-\d{10}), address synthetic. Every öre integer stays < 10 digits (orgnr-scan safe). Cases are origin:new-expected; the vat display posture stays the tenant setting AS-IS (private→incl is resolved elsewhere). Reference the existing money/settings fixtures as the single numeric authority — the öre here are fresh, representative pricing rows for a genuinely-new comparison category (settings/pricing was not pinned by a prior lovable oracle).
